raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure consists of two line graphs, labeled A and B, both plotting data over a time period from 2008 to 2021 on the x-axis, which is labeled "Години" (Years). The y-axis of graph A is labeled "Средни петгодни (дни)" (Average five-year (days)) and uses a linear scale ranging from 200 to 280, with major tick marks at intervals of 20. The y-axis of graph B is labeled "Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)" (Structural effect on average bed days (%)) and uses a linear scale ranging from 1.0 to 2.0, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. In graph A, a red line connects data points at the following approximate coordinates: (2008, 280), (2012, 270), (2017, 245), and (2021, 210). In graph B, a red line connects data points at the following approximate coordinates: (2008, 1.6), (2012, 1.1), (2017, 1.4), and (2021, 2.1).
